answer: Ravenswood (GSQ site 481934): what might remain today, from official services and registers checked on 2026-11-23; each record carries its source, the query URL and the check time. Exploration: 12 mineral boreholes within 2 km listed (nearest Mellaneur Selmadier MSD93 at 609 m, CARPENTARA GOLD PTY LTD; no drill dates recorded); 1 MINOCC-linked company report listed (latest: CR 6538 "EPM 1853 BLACK PINNACLE SIX MONTHLY REPORT FOR PERIOD ENDING 10/5/1978", 1978). Resources: 10 records, each a modern reported resource (JORC/as published), not historical production and not a claim about what remains: Copper Knob / Copper Knob (Polymetallic) Gold as at 2025-01-01 (JORC code): measured resource 620 kt at 1.06 g/t, about 21,129 troy ounces contained (derived); indicated resource 960 kt at 0.74 g/t, about 22,840 troy ounces contained (derived); inferred resource 580 kt at 0.74 g/t, about 13,799 troy ounces contained (derived) | Ravenswood / Bucks Reef  West Gold as at 2014-06-30 (JORC code): measured resource 17.9 Mt at 1.1 g/t, about 631,527 troy ounces contained (derived); indicated resource 11.6 Mt at 0.9 g/t, about 335,133 troy ounces contained (derived); inferred resource 12.4 Mt at 0.9 g/t, about 357,645 troy ounces contained (derived) | Sarsfield Gold as at 2013-06-30 (JORC code): proved reserve 28.5 Mt at 0.8 g/t, about 731,751 troy ounces contained (derived); probable reserve 18.6 Mt at 0.7 g/t, about 419,503 troy ounces contained (derived); measured resource 16.2 Mt at 0.8 g/t, about 416,288 troy ounces contained (derived); indicated resource 20.4 Mt at 0.7 g/t, about 458,753 troy ounces contained (derived) | Sarsfield / Sarsfield Stockpiles Gold as at 2011-06-30 (JORC code): probable reserve 250 kt at 0.6 g/t, about 4,823 troy ounces contained (derived). Access: nearest town Ravenswood (0.4 km, population 349); nearest town of 1,000 or more people Charters Towers (65.7 km, population 8234); nearest major road FLINDERS HIGHWAY A6 (32 km; national or state highway, sealed); nearest operational power line Strathmore to Ross 275 kV (26.1 km); straight-line distance, not route distance. Environment: 6 environmental authorities listed (1 over the site point, for example EPSX00614213 RAVENSWOOD GOLD PTY LTD, granted); 0 abandoned-mines records, 0 of them tailings; 7 recorded mine openings within 2 km. Not found or not checked: environment: contaminated-land and environmental-management registers: no keyless official spatial layer was found among the Queensland map services (layer names searched 2026-11-23), so they are not checked. Note: exploration: 12 mineral boreholes within 2 km; 0 with a rig-release date, 12 without; operators named: CARPENTARA GOLD PTY LTD, RAVENSWOOD GOLD PTY LTD, MOUNT ISA MINES EXPLORATION, GEOLOGICAL SURVEY OF QUEENSLAND; exploration: MINOCC links 1 company report to this site; 1 found in the GSQ report index with a title and year, 0 not (the index holds open-file reports with a mapped extent only); resources: Nolans (ENO 333318, 0.6 km, location accuracy 2000 m); Ravenswood (ENO 336045, 0.9 km, location accuracy 2000 m); Sarsfield (ENO 334108, 1.2 km, location accuracy 999 m); Copper Knob (ENO 333452, 1.5 km, location accuracy 10 m); 18 resource records across all reporting dates, the latest per zone and commodity listed (10); earlier reporting dates are not listed; environment: no abandoned-mines tailings polygon within 2 km. These records show what has been drilled, reported, mapped or registered near the site. They are not an estimate of gold remaining and say nothing about whether any deposit is economic; that needs a geologist. Modern reported resources are kept apart from historical production.

remaining_caveat: These records show what has been drilled, reported, mapped or registered near the site. They are not an estimate of gold remaining and say nothing about whether any deposit is economic; that needs a geologist. Modern reported resources are kept apart from historical production.

caveats.exploration: A borehole or company report near the site is evidence that exploration took place, not of what it found: no assay or result is given here. Boreholes are those on the Geological Survey of Queensland mineral boreholes layer; many have no drill date recorded.
caveats.resources: Each figure is modern reported resource (JORC/as published), not historical production and not a claim about what remains. Tonnes, grade and category are as published by Geoscience Australia from company reports; contained metal is derived here as tonnes times grade and is not a published figure.
caveats.access: All distances are straight-line distance, not route distance; they say nothing about road condition, legal access or the cost of connecting power.
caveats.environment: A register or abandoned-mines record is not an assessment of liability, contamination or rehabilitation cost. Contaminated-land and environmental-management registers were not available as keyless spatial layers and are not checked.
